systems.system: Angola cross-border fibre links to DRC and Namibia

AGO.note: MoU names cross-border fibre as an area only, no facility; links to DRC and Namibia have no arrangement or parties named.

ZMB.note: Angola only says it is interested in a fibre link to Zambia; no facility named.

facts.fact: Angola's telecommunications minister signed an ICT cooperation MoU with Zambia's science and technology minister at ANGOTIC 2023, covering AI, space technology and cross-border fibre.
